def greens(fr):
    g=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='N': g.append((min(r),min(c)))
    return sorted(g)
before = greens(current_frame)
print('before count', len(before))
# Test: click a DISTANT block (9,15) and a NEAR block (33,33)
r1 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':9,'col':15}])
mid = greens(current_frame)
print('after distant click (9,15): count', len(mid), 'no_impact', r1.get('no_impact'), 'board_changed', r1.get('board_changed'))
r2 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':33}])
after = greens(current_frame)
print('after near click (33,33): count', len(after), 'no_impact', r2.get('no_impact'), 'board_changed', r2.get('board_changed'))
print('removed by distant:', [g for g in before if g not in mid])
print('removed by near:', [g for g in mid if g not in after])
